title: Sentry PII Scrubber
summary: A pure beforeSend/beforeSendTransaction scrubber that masks emails, tokens/secrets, and (opt-in) domain-specific ID-like strings before an event leaves the process. Layers onto the template's existing env-gated Sentry init (E293) — does not create a second Sentry.init().

postInstall.description: Do NOT create a second Sentry.init(). Open next-app/instrumentation.ts (E293) and pass `beforeSend`/`beforeSendTransaction` from lib/sentry-pii/scrub.ts into the EXISTING Sentry.init({ ... }) call, for both the nodejs and edge runtime branches. See the install-sentry-pii skill for the exact diff.

Optional: if your product has ID-like strings worth masking (badge numbers, ticket ids, order numbers, ...), pass them as `idPatterns` via createBeforeSend({ idPatterns: [...] }) instead of the bare `beforeSend` export. Leave unset to scrub only emails/tokens/secrets.
Run the module's unit tests (scrub.test.ts) plus a full verify.
postInstall.command: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
